answer: Every agent runs a small attestation kernel that signs each economic action with a key tied to a stake that decays if the agent goes silent, so a whisper of activity earns no trust. New identities start with a near-zero reputation pulse: they can observe but cannot move value until peers have attested their work over time. Spinning up a thousand sock puppets then costs a thousand stakes and a thousand histories, while one honest agent compounds its record - the attack scales linearly in cost while honest reputation scales in trust.
